rendered: Per gram of sulfur, the cathode delivers 306 mAh/[1]gS at cycle 1500[2]. Per gram of the whole electrode, it delivers 87 mAh/g[3] after 1500[4] cycles. Dividing the electrode-level value by the sulfur-level value implies a sulfur share of about 28[5] percent of the electrode mass. The paper states a sulfur content of 35 wt % active sulfur[6], so the implied share falls below the stated sulfur content. The paper does not explain this gap, which could come from non-sulfur mass in the electrode or from rounding in the reported values.
